_source: Code of Practice for Site Supervision 2009 (2024 Edition, rev. Aug 2024), BD, paras 4.1-4.6, 8.4-8.8, Table 8.1; Technical Memorandum for Supervision Plans 2009, Table 2 and the frequency key of Table 1. Read via automated extraction 2026-11-05. The row-by-row grades and frequencies of TM Table 1 were NOT extracted reliably and are not encoded: enter them from the TM.

T1.min: certificate or diploma + 2 years relevant experience

T4.min: degree + 4 years, or a registered professional

5.text: full-time inspection during site working hours

streams.AS: Authorized Signatory of the registered contractor (RGBC / RSC)

scale_basic_values._note: Table 8.1. Scale factor = estimated value / basic value, capped at 2 (para 8.5). Factor 1 = full-day TCP inspection each occasion (8.7); below 1 allows shorter visits, never fewer (8.7-8.8).

demolition.measure: max floor area demolished per storey

gifw_pits.measure: trial pits, coreholes, slope strippings concurrently (no drillholes)

slope_repair.measure: total cost (slope / retaining wall / buried services repair)

elsw.measure: average cost per month (excavation & lateral support)

large_dia_bored_piles.measure: average cost per month (large diameter bored / barrette piles)

other_piles.measure: average cost per month (piles other than the above)

curtain_wall.measure: total aggregated surface area (curtain wall / cladding)

rules.text: Supervision plan names each TCP and the frequency / extent of supervision; submit before or with the consent application.
AP lodges the plan with or before the first consent application; minor works (simplified requirements): ≥ 7 days before commencement.
Confirm TCP appointments as an annex to the plan or within 7 days of commencement.
AP / RSE / RGE / AS notify the BA of any subsequent change of TCP.
Revised plan when a revised contract sum changes the scale factor and resources.
Full-time TCPs stationed on site; minimum frequency in TM Table 1 must not be reduced.
Temporary works supporting a tower crane: designer and independent checker each a registered professional engineer (civil / structural) with ≥ 5 years relevant experience.
Soil nailing: at least one TCP T3 (RGE stream) and one TCP T1 (RSC stream) resident full-time at every stage.
Significant geotechnical works: RGE normally provides TCP T3 and T5.
